tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | 5+ yrs SAP Commerce, AI-assisted, Java/Spring
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in AI-assisted analysis, CI/CD deployments, production support and techno-functional consulting with international stakeholders.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about adesso SE’s commitment to AI-driven digital commerce. With 5+ years building SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise that aligns perfectly with your vision.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features, covering product, catalog and pricing, using Java and Spring best practices.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST services and built robust PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub) that synchronized global product data across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: AI-assisted Development
bullets.text: Leveraged generative AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, code generation, testing and documentation, shortening delivery cycles.

bullets.label: Techno-functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs and production-ready solutions, supporting UAT and post-go-live support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holding a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026 and available to start 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to adesso SE.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_de.hook: Die AI-gestützte Digitalstrategie von adesso SE begeistert mich. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud-Projekten bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich das nötige Fachwissen für Ihre Vorhaben mit.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Cloud-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Funktionen für Produkt- und Preisverwaltung unter Einsatz von Java und Spring.

bullets.label: API- und Integrationskenntnisse
bullets.text: Erstellte OCC-REST-Services und robuste PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub) zur Synchronisation globaler Produktdaten mit ERP- und MDM-Systemen.

bullets.label: AI-unterstützte Entwicklung
bullets.text: Setzte generative KI-Tools ein, um Anforderungsanalyse, Code-Generierung, Tests und Dokumentation effizient zu beschleunigen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit Fachbereichen zusammen, übersetzte Anforderungen in User Stories, funktionale Spezifikationen und produktionsreife Lösungen, inklusive UAT-Begleitung.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: adesso SE stands out as a leading digital transformation partner that combines deep SAP expertise with cutting-edge AI solutions. Your focus on innovative commerce platforms and the opportunity to work on high-impact projects across Germany align perfectly with my background in SAP Commerce Cloud, AI-assisted development and international techno-functional consulting. I am eager to contribute to your mission and grow within your forward-thinking team.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join adesso SE to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and AI-driven development skills to innovative digital commerce projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the Hybris Developer role at adesso SE and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position. With over five years of hands-on experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to adesso SE’s AI-driven commerce initiatives.

Kind regards,
Kranti Chavan
